description: Golden message fixtures of DEP 1.0 (PRO-110): for every message type, valid frames (required members only; every member) and invalid ones. A receiver accepts every valid frame and refuses every invalid one: `fatal` frames close the connection with 4400, the others are answered with a non-fatal bad_message (decision D03).
